name: Baba Au Rhum
signature_dish: all-butter croissant with the morning quiche
why_it_matters: Goa's defining French bakery — opened in 2006 by French chefs Leo Michaud and Dayini Feraud on a back lane of Sim Vaddo. Everything that leaves the counter is baked on-site that morning: baguettes, croissants, pain au chocolat, quiches and the namesake rum baba. The paddy-field garden has been the North Goa breakfast destination for almost two decades.
insider_tip: Walk in before 10am for first-batch croissants; by noon the popular quiches sell out. The pizzas come out of the wood oven from sundown — different kitchen, equally good. Skip the meal mains; the bakery counter is the reason to come.
signature_address: House No. 1054, Sim Vaddo, near Premiere Inn, Anjuna, Bardez, Goa 403509

name: Bean Me Up
why_it_matters: India's oldest 100% vegan restaurant — founded in 1996 by Lisa, who was sourcing organic soy and making tempeh in Goa decades before the rest of the country had heard of either. Long predates the wellness wave; the kitchen still ferments its own tofu and tempeh in-house every day. Award-winning, and the spiritual home of plant-based eating in India.
insider_tip: The tempeh and tofu are the menu's reason for being — order at least one dish that features them. The garden cottages on the same property let you stretch a long lunch into a stay.
signature_address: 1639/2 Devulvaddo, Ozran beach road, Vagator, Bardez, Goa 403509

name: Artjuna
why_it_matters: The cafe that put homestyle Israeli food on Goa's map — opened in 2009 by Israeli founder Moshe Inbar and his partner Anastasia, originally as a small cafe and lifestyle shop. Fifteen-plus years on, it has expanded into a full courtyard with restaurant, boutique, kids' play area, yoga and workshops. No alcohol, no drugs — a deliberate counterpoint to Anjuna's party scene.
insider_tip: Book a courtyard table for the Israeli breakfast spread; the indoor seating misses the foliage. The boutique upstairs is where Tel Aviv designers stock up — worth a browse after the meal.

name: Mojigao
why_it_matters: A forest cafe inside a boutique eco-resort, opened in 2018 by Israeli restaurateur Moshe Inbar (also of Artjuna) on a landscaped Assagao plot. Mediterranean and Middle Eastern menu with unusual depth on gluten-free, vegan and clean-eating dishes — the brunch hub for Assagao's wellness crowd, with yoga on the hill and seafood and tapas through the evening.
insider_tip: Brunch is what Mojigao is built for — book a garden table before noon. The gluten-free baked goods rotate daily; ask at the counter rather than ordering off the printed list. Mosquitoes find you in the evening; sit higher up on the slope.

name: Cafe Diogo
signature_dish: avocado, cheese and mushroom toasted sandwich
why_it_matters: The original hippie-era cafe of Anjuna — started in the early 1970s by Diogo 'Joe Banana' Almeida, who rode his bicycle to the market and rustled up meals for the first wave of foreigners camping on the beach. The cafe doubled as the area's poste restante: every overseas letter to a hippie was addressed 'c/o Joe Banana'. Now run by Diogo's son Tony, still simple, still cheap, still on Market Road.
insider_tip: Open 8.30am to about 4pm — pure breakfast and lunch place, no dinner. The fruit salads with curd and honey are the classic order. Cash preferred. Closed on the odd off-season day; check before you walk over.

name: German Bakery
why_it_matters: The original German Bakery — set up in South Anjuna by Klaus 'Woody Pumpernickel' Gutzeit in the late 1970s after he noticed the locals and travellers had nowhere to find good bread. The first health-food cafe of the Anjuna scene; all the German Bakery branches across India (Pune, Lonavala, Leh, Kasol) trace back to this one. Forty-plus years on, still floor seating, still its own bread, still a small lending library.
insider_tip: The bread is the point — order anything sandwich-shaped or take a loaf to go. Sit on the floor cushions, not the tables; that's where the cafe's bohemian spirit still lives. Mornings are unhurried, evenings get the long-stay crowd.
signature_address: East of the Market Road, near Nirvana Heritage, South Anjuna, Bardez, Goa 403509
